reason: The CLAUDE.md guidance (patch lines 10-18) says to use isinstance() rather than hasattr() on union types. The flusher change itself does this: `processes` is typed as `SpawnProcess | threading.Thread` (flusher.py patch line 126), and it guards `kill()` with `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` (patch line 303). The doc addition comes from this change, so 'nothing to do with it' is wrong, although bundling a doc tweak into the PR is debatable at most.
